faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Bharathiar University Director Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Director post at Bharathiar University is 03 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in Bharathiar University Director Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Director post in Bharathiar University Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Director post at Bharathiar University?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Director post should not be more than 62 years of age.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for the Director position at Bharathiar University?
faq.answer: The salary for the Director post ranges from Rs. 1,75,000 to Rs. 2,00,000 per month, based on experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for Bharathiar University Director Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the Bharathiar University Director Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the required qualification for the Director post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Doctoral/Master’s Degree in Engineering, Technology or Science with 25 years of experience in relevant domains.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Director post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Director post includes CV screening and a reference check.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for the Bharathiar University Director Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply by sending their complete application along with required documents via email to the official email address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for the Director position?
faq.answer: The Director position at Bharathiar University is a Contract-based job.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the job location for the Director post?
faq.answer: The job location for the Director post is Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu.
